_source: Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited (NSE Emerge, symbol MAXENGS). The RHP sits on nsearchives.nseindia.com, which this environment cannot reach, and SME offer documents are not posted on SEBI. Figures are restated financials (FY24-FY26 and four months to 31-Jul-2026) as reproduced from the offer document by public IPO trackers (HDFC Sky, Chittorgarh, Chanakya Niti, IPO Central, unp.me), cross-checked against each other on 29-Oct-2026. Revenue is total income (the trackers do not split other income). Items marked 'estimate' are analyst estimates, not reported figures. No page cites are possible until the RHP is read. Price band, issue size and dates are from the NSE issue page.

basis.name: Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited
basis.outside: RHP not reachable (NSE archive host blocked); figures from public trackers reproducing the offer document

cites.rev: Restated total income FY24-26 and 4M to Jul-2026 (HDFC Sky, Chittorgarh, unp.me)

1.finding: EPS Rs 11.80 on PAT Rs 11.86 cr and NAV Rs 24.74 on net worth Rs 24.87 cr both imply about 1.005 crore pre-issue shares; post-issue P/E 18.25x at Rs 158 reconciles on 1.370 crore shares.

2.finding: Operating cash flow not available. Total assets rose to Rs 47.55 cr (Mar-26) and borrowings to Rs 16.73 cr while PAT was Rs 11.86 cr, so part of profit is being reinvested in plant and working capital.

3.finding: Tax split not available; PAT is 78% of EBITDA, which suggests a concessional tax rate or material other income - to be checked in the RHP.

4.finding: Related-party transactions not available. The company was incorporated in Sep-2022; whether it took over an earlier promoter business (and on what terms) is not known without the RHP.

5.finding: Objects Rs 42.80 cr (machinery and lab equipment 18.00 + building 6.50 + debt repayment 4.30 + working capital 14.00) over 36.48 lakh fresh shares = Rs 125 a share after 6% assumed expenses, below the Rs 150 floor.

8.finding: Customer and geographic concentration not available; the company says it exports to 50+ countries. A single plant at Waghodia GIDC, Vadodara.

9.finding: Contingent liabilities and litigation not available.

R1.finding: Auditor and any qualifications not available.

R3.finding: Fresh issue Rs 57.64 cr: monitoring agency mandatory above Rs 50 cr; to be named in the RHP.

R5.finding: SME eligibility: incorporated Sep-2022, so the operating track record is short; not re-computed from the RHP.

R6.finding: JDA Capital Services (sole BRLM): track record not compiled. One tracker names Religo Capital Advisors (DRHP stage).

rationale.g1: Total income Rs 10.87 / 22.59 / 30.76 cr FY24-26 (+108%, +36%); Rs 12.25 cr in 4M FY27 (Rs 36.75 cr annualised, +19%). The issue funds Rs 18 cr of machinery and lab equipment and a new building, adding capacity from FY28. Neutral 20% then 18 / 15 / 12 / 10%; Bear 6-8%; Bull 30% fading to 12%.
rationale.m: EBITDA margin 51.58% in FY26 (EBITDA Rs 15.19 cr) but 36.11% in 4M FY27 (Rs 4.29 cr). Aftermarket parts for underwater pelletizers are niche and high-value, but a 50% margin is unusual and has already come down. Neutral 38% (near the latest period); Bear 30%; Bull 45%.
rationale.nwc: Estimate: not reported by trackers. An exporter of machined components carries receivables and inventory; assumed Rs 12 cr (39% of revenue) for FY26 and Rs 8 cr for FY25. Neutral 38%; Bear 42%; Bull 34%.
rationale.roic: RoNW 47.70% and ROCE 38.46% in FY26 (10.93% and 9.87% for 4M FY27, not annualised). Terminal ROIC 22% (Neutral) for a niche engineering business after the issue doubles the capital base.
rationale.capex: Estimates: D&A Rs 0.8 cr and maintenance-plus-organic capex Rs 2.0 cr a year (fixed assets are not disclosed by trackers). Capacity expansion is funded separately by the IPO capex object, Rs 24.50 cr (machinery and lab equipment Rs 18.00 cr + building Rs 6.50 cr), modelled 60% in Y1 and 40% in Y2, so organic capex is kept modest to avoid counting the same expansion twice. Net debt taken as gross borrowings Rs 16.73 cr (cash not disclosed). Fresh issue 36,48,000 shares = Rs 57.64 cr at Rs 158.
rationale.relative: No usable peer: the two listed engineering names cited by trackers (Omnitech Engineering, Sunita Tools) trade near 100x earnings on RoNW of about 11%, a valuation driven by listing premia rather than earnings, and their figures come from a single unchecked table. They are shown but excluded, so fair value rests on the DCF alone (the model's rule when no peer is included).

peers: Precision engineered components - tracker's peer; P/E ~99x, excluded
Tooling and machined parts - tracker's peer; P/E ~101x, excluded

kpi._cite: FY26 EBITDA Rs 15.19 cr and margin 51.58% (HDFC Sky, Chittorgarh); 4M FY27 EBITDA Rs 4.29 cr, margin 36.11%.
